Execute only commands you trust. PRoot shares this app’s Android UID and is not a sandbox; commands can access app-private data and the network. No API tokens are injected. Maximum duration: 15 minutes. Background child processes stop with the session.
Native plugins included in this signed app. Review permissions to activate. Installation adds no external code or credentials.
Read GitHub files; write feature branches and create draft pull requests after explicit review. Uses your scoped GitHub token.
Read Workers and deploy reviewed changes with your scoped Cloudflare token. Each deployment requires separate approval.
Run trusted project build scripts with the app’s Android UID and export Debug APKs. Review every build.
Run manually approved Linux commands with app UID and network access. No Android root or separate kernel. Review every command.
Remove the plugin and block further operations. Its saved service token is deleted. Already submitted remote operations cannot be undone by removal.
